title: Beyond Black Boxes: Visual Grounding for Text Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2610.18047v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this paper, our goal is to represent text embeddings as sketches for three main reasons. First, to visualize text representation and to explore their potential their potential for AI explainability. Second, to investigate the potential benefits of the sketch-based representation for information retrieval. Third, to explore their potential for reasoning, drawing inspiration from the concept of mental imagery. We propose a sketch-based visual grounding framework that transforms text representations into visual topographic sketches. Our approach aims to emphasis the semantics content encoded in the text embeddings through the corresponding sketch. translated_title: 超越黑箱：文本嵌入的视觉接地
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们的目标是出于三个主要原因将文本嵌入表示为草图。首先，为了可视化文本表示，并探索其在AI可解释性方面的潜力。其次，研究基于草图的表示对信息检索的潜在益处。第三，借鉴心理意象（mental imagery）的概念，探索其在推理方面的潜力。我们提出了一个基于草图的视觉接地框架，将文本表示转换为视觉地形草图。我们的方法旨在通过相应的草图突出显示文本嵌入中所编码的语义内容。我们在MS-COCO数据集上进行了评估，以检验这些草图在文本检索中的实用性。对SBERT和基于草图方法的对比研究表明，SBERT在严格的top-1检索准确率上保持优势，而草图方法达到了与其相当的性能……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将文本嵌入转换为视觉草图的接地框架，以增强AI可解释性、辅助信息检索并支持基于心理意象的推理，实验表明其检索性能接近SBERT，但严格的top-1准确率稍逊。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a sketch-based visual grounding framework that transforms text embeddings into visual topographic sketches for AI explainability, information retrieval, and mental-imagery-inspired reasoning, achieving retrieval performance comparable to SBERT while slightly lagging in strict top-1 accuracy.
